classification.contract: Every catalog identity is classified exactly once. GT6-backed fields retain their source fact and transformation id; fields without a GT6 fact are explicit DESIGN_POLICY and are excluded from GT6 parity claims.
classification.large_role_ambiguity: A material with multiple large-role candidates is not selected by proximity or name; it falls through unless an independent reviewed override is added.
classification.dimension_policy: The existing overworld acquisition contract is retained as DESIGN_POLICY_OVERWORLD_ACCESS; GT6 dimensions are recorded as source facts but are not represented as direct parity.

large_geometry_v1.vertical_radius: 3, derived from the seven GT6 role levels tMinY-1 through tMinY+5

small_geometry_v1.layers: the single source material is repeated in all four CC roles

random_small_gem_geometry_v1.source_parameters: GT6 dynamic row min_y=5, max_y=250, amount=1

design_policy_hash_v1.purpose: Deterministically distribute non-GT6-owned catalog resources without presenting the values as source facts.

identity_preserving_profile_v2.rule: Configured/placed feature ids and salts remain unchanged. Existing generated blocks are not rewritten; unexplored chunks consume profile_version=2. Unsupported profile versions fail codec validation.

non_claims: The 129 CrucibleCraft catalog identities are 129 canonical GT6 large veins.
DESIGN_POLICY rows have GT6 geometry parity.
The NeoForge placement algorithm is behaviorally identical to the Minecraft 1.7.10 GT6 generator.
Third-party mod-native worldgen is reproduced without a separately pinned source.
